Definition: from a presumed compound of G4314 and G5368; friendly towards, i.e. acceptable:--lovely.
BiblicalUsage: Prosphiles means lovely, friendly toward, acceptable. It appears once, in Paul's list of what to think on: whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report, think on these things.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe what is lovely is not decoration but discipline: my thoughts go where I aim them, and Paul aims mine at what is true and pure.
